transcript: Never ever drink water when you eat. Here's why. My friend, when you drink water while you're eating, you dilute your stomach acid. And when that acid weakens, your body can't properly break down the food. That's when the body starts to feel heavy, bloated, uncomfortable, but look a little deeper. The problem isn't just the water, it's the way you eat. Most people rush, they chew too little, swallow too fast, and then use water to push the food down. That's not nourishment, that's impatience. Slow down just a little. Chew your food properly. Let digestion begin in your mouth, not your stomach. When you eat with more awareness, you'll notice something simple. You don't need the water as much. The body already knows what to do. If this made you think, comment, slow below, and share this with someone who always rushes their meals.
